title: urnetwork / sn claim relay
description: The settlement v2 claim relay (apple BTEASY.md, "Claim relay"; server controller/sn_claim_relay.go): relayer balance, spend against the daily cap, claims pending and refused, the cap and the stops. Counts and amounts only; no coldkey, network or account is a label. Each worker keeps its last pass's gauges, so these panels read the worker with the newest pass.

panels.title: relay state
panels.description: The state of the newest pass. no_key means no relayer key is configured, so the relay reads and sends nothing. griefing_stop means a claim's gas jumped, and low_balance that the relayer cannot pay the next claim.

targets.expr: max by (state) (urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_state{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} and on (env, service, block, host, instance) (urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} == scalar(max(urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""})))) == 1

panels.title: last pass age
panels.description: Seconds since a worker last finished a pass. One worker at a time runs it, about every five minutes, and a pass may wait for one claim's finality.

panels.title: relayer balance
panels.description: The relayer account's balance at the newest pass. It holds only operating TAO. A single claim needs about 0.0014 TAO on hand, and the alert warns under 3 days of the cap.

targets.expr: urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_relayer_balance_tao{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} and on (env, service, block, host, instance) (urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} == scalar(max(urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""})))

panels.title: spent today of the cap
panels.description: TAO the relayer's transactions of this UTC day paid, and the most its unfinished ones can, against the daily cap.

targets.expr: urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_spent_today_tao{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} and on (env, service, block, host, instance) (urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} == scalar(max(urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""})))

urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_daily_cap_tao{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} and on (env, service, block, host, instance) (urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} == scalar(max(urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""})))

panels.title: relayer balance over time
panels.description: The relayer's balance. A steady fall of at most the daily cap is claims; anything faster is not.

targets.expr: urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_relayer_balance_tao{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} and on (env, service, block, host, instance) (urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} == scalar(max(urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""})))

panels.title: spend
panels.description: This UTC day's spend against the cap. It starts again at 00:00 UTC.

targets.expr: urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_spent_today_tao{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} and on (env, service, block, host, instance) (urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} == scalar(max(urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""})))

urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_daily_cap_tao{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} and on (env, service, block, host, instance) (urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} == scalar(max(urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""})))

panels.title: claims pending
panels.description: Claims the relay would send now, and the accounts over the automatic threshold among them. Past the cap they wait for the next UTC day; v2 credit never expires.

targets.expr: urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_claims_pending{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} and on (env, service, block, host, instance) (urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} == scalar(max(urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""})))

urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_accounts_over_threshold{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} and on (env, service, block, host, instance) (urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} == scalar(max(urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""})))

panels.title: claims paid today
panels.description: Claims the relayer's finalized transactions paid in this UTC day, and accounts waiting after a refusal.

targets.expr: urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_claims_paid_today{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} and on (env, service, block, host, instance) (urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} == scalar(max(urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""})))

urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_accounts_refused{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} and on (env, service, block, host, instance) (urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} == scalar(max(urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""})))

panels.title: claims by result
panels.description: Claims the relay tried, an hour at a time. A refused claim leaves the rest alone. not_attempted is a batch's gas running out before it; it is due again.

panels.title: passes by state
panels.description: Passes an hour at a time, by the state each ended in.

panels.title: gas price
panels.description: The chain's gas price. Above 10 gwei nothing is sent.

targets.expr: urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_gas_price_gwei{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} and on (env, service, block, host, instance) (urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} == scalar(max(urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""})))

panels.title: claim preflight gas
panels.description: The gas of the last claim preflight. A claim is about 150,000 to 207,000. At 400,000 the relay stops: third parties filling vault2's staking-hotkey list take a claim to about 1.26M.

targets.expr: urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_estimate_gas{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} and on (env, service, block, host, instance) (urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} == scalar(max(urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""})))

panels.title: alpha price
panels.description: TAO per alpha at the newest pass, which turns a balance into the TAO value the policy reads.

targets.expr: urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_alpha_price_tao{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} and on (env, service, block, host, instance) (urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""} == scalar(max(urnetwork_sn_claim_relay_last_pass_timestamp_seconds{env="$env",service="taskworker",instance!=""})))

panels.title: Claim now taps
panels.description: Claim now taps an hour at a time, on the api: accepted, or refused because it is not available for that coldkey now.
